findings.statement: Three explicitly declared family/rule pairs derive exact minima consistently across the tested finite cases.
Unsupported family/rule combinations are rejected rather than evaluated under an implicit fallback rule.
The model does not establish a universal family taxonomy or derive the domain descriptors and admissibility rules from deeper governing semantics.
findings.evidence: Family descriptors and three rule definitions are supplied finite inputs.

required_follow_up: do not infer universal domain taxonomy
